newsitem.title: CHINA: Spinoff news boosts Guangdong Inv shares.
newsitem.headline: Spinoff news boosts Guangdong Inv shares.

text.p: Shares of Guangdong Investment Ltd rose on Monday on hopes of an exceptional gain after the company announced it would float its brewery business, brokers said.

"Hopes of an exceptional gain following the spinoff and news that existing company shareholders will have preference in buying the shares fuelled demand for the stock," said Antony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
Guangdong Investment shares were up HK$0.35 at HK$11.45 at midday after hitting a high of HK$12.00.
The company said earlier on Monday it would float its Guangdong Brewery Holdings Ltd unit by offering 350 million new shares, representing 28 percent of the enlarged share capital.
About 216.62 million shares would be reserved for Guangdong Investment shareholders in the proportion of one brewery share for every eight parent shares held.
Trading in the brewery shares is due to begin in Hong Kong on August 8.
